title: Sam Altman Just Revealed OpenAI's Secret AGI Timeline
angle: Altman's public comments contain a hidden admission: AGI is not decades away — it's already on OpenAI's internal roadmap with a specific target window, and the implications for every human on Earth are being deliberately downplayed.

scenes.voiceover: Sam Altman just accidentally revealed when AGI actually arrives. Most people completely missed it.
scenes.visual_description: Extreme close-up of Altman mid-sentence at a podium, freeze-frame at the exact word. Giant red circle highlights his mouth. Clock graphic slams onto screen.
scenes.caption_overlay: He said it out loud. Nobody noticed.

scenes.scene_name: The Setup — What He Actually Said
scenes.voiceover: In three separate interviews this month, Altman stopped saying 'decades away' and started saying 'within our planning horizon.'
scenes.visual_description: Split-screen of three interview clips timestamped. Specific phrase 'planning horizon' highlighted in yellow each time. Fast cuts between clips.

scenes.scene_name: The Decode — What Planning Horizon Means
scenes.voiceover: OpenAI's own charter defines planning horizon as 3 to 5 years. That means their internal AGI target is 2027 to 2028.
scenes.visual_description: OpenAI charter document zooms in on the exact definition. Timeline graphic appears — 2024 to 2028 with a glowing target at the end. Numbers slam in one by one.

scenes.scene_name: The Stakes — Why This Changes Everything
scenes.voiceover: If they hit that window, every white-collar job, every creative field, every government system faces disruption simultaneously. At once.
scenes.visual_description: Rapid montage: trading floors, hospital wards, courtrooms, music studios — each overlaid with an AI interface dissolving the human workers. Speed ramps up to near-blinding pace.

scenes.scene_name: The Contrast — What They're Telling the Public
scenes.voiceover: But every press release still says 'we don't know when AGI comes.' Two stories. One company. Ask yourself why.
scenes.visual_description: Kognai on camera, deadpan expression, holds up printed OpenAI press release in one hand, phone showing the charter quote in the other. Slow zoom into eyes at the end.
scenes.caption_overlay: They know. They just won't tell you.

scenes.scene_name: The Loop — Back to the Slip
scenes.voiceover: Go back and watch Altman's lips. He already told you. 'Within our planning horizon.' Now you can't unhear it.
scenes.visual_description: Replay of opening freeze-frame with the clock graphic. Text counts down from 2028 to NOW. Final frame: same extreme close-up as scene 1, loop implied.
scenes.caption_overlay: Watch it again. You'll see it.

hook_test.format_reference: The real reason X happened — hidden explanation with conspiracy-adjacent reveal
hook_test.viral_proof: Videos using the 'they accidentally revealed' framing — including the Snowden NSA leak reacts and the Google sentient AI engineer leak — consistently hit 10M–40M views. The freeze-frame-on-a-quote mechanic is a proven pattern used by channels like Wall Street Millennial and ColdFusion reaching 15M+ per upload in tech-disclosure content.
hook_test.why_it_works: Combines insider knowledge framing with a concrete number (2027-2028) that makes the abstract feel real and imminent. The viewer feels smarter than the crowd for watching — a core driver of saves and shares. The loop ending forces rewatches to catch the 'slip' again.
